SUMMARY: Fixed array field serialization in set command. When fieldType is array, setScalarField now splits comma-separated input via parseArrayValue, stores the value as a JSON array in pending_changes payload (using map[string]interface{} instead of map[string]string), and stores JSON-marshaled array for the optimistic local DB update. Writer processSetField already uses interface{} for Value so it sends the array correctly to Jira. Added tests for parseArrayValue and round-trip serialization.. Comma-separated keys (ROX-1,ROX-2) are split and expanded. Bulk mode prints summary count (human) or {count,keys} JSON. Zero-row queries produce clear error. Unit tests for expandKeys and extractKeys.. FILES: internal/cli/set.go. CONTEXT: 30%
